Cattleman's Ball website displayed on screen, showing multi-state event locations including Texas, Kansas, Oregon, Florida, and Nebraska

artifacts.bundle_name: TPUSA Cease and Desist Letter Bundle

sub_items.description: Cease and Desist letter displayed on screen and read aloud, sent by Turning Point USA (via Paramount Tactical) to Zack Gregorio of Wolves and Finance, including the formal statement on drones ("UVU prohibited Turning Point USA from flying drones for security purposes during the event, but did allow a Turning Point USA media production drone to briefly fly over the location before the event to collect limited B-roll footage")
Zack Gregorio (Wolves and Finance) YouTube video clip played on air, showing Gregorio presenting the cease-and-desist letter, characterizing it as the first step toward a defamation lawsuit
Andrew Kovat interview clip played on air (with Gary), explaining the drone situation, stating Frank Turk saw a wide-angle shot from a second-floor walkway taken by the events team, not drone footage
Wide-angle shot image displayed on screen, presented by Andrew Kovat as the photo Frank Turk mistook for drone footage (described as "a walkway or a bridge elevated" second-floor view)
Erica Kirk interview clip played on air in which she states she was "living in China and doing a lot of work with victims from sex trafficking" through her Everyday Heroes Like You charity
Paraphrased TPUSA official response (received via email by host), stating that Erica Kirk "never lived" in China and "simply visited for 2 weeks"
Charlie Kirk debate clip with Ben Corollo played on air, in which Charlie states "Unlike you, my wife lived in China for 6 months"

Pastor Gary Ham video announcement for a Cornerstone Chapel Wednesday night service on January 21, identifying the topic as antisemitism, listing Candace Owens and Tucker Carlson, and naming Rob McCoy and Samuel Smaja as guests
Fox News article reference read aloud by host, with headline: "Israel will honor the late Charlie Kirk with an award for opposing anti-semitism"
"Moderator Marzy" comment read aloud, claiming Dan Flood was "still providing security" at a Charlie Kirk Day event where Kash Patel was present
"Becca" comment read aloud, asserting Erika Kirk is "panicking" and "not leading that organization in a direction that Charlie Kirk would have let it there"

"Scrub Girl" comment read aloud, stating "I grew up in Converse, Texas, and no New Bronzeville/New Bron Falls, Texas… it's definitely expanding rapidly the past couple of years. Yeah, I believe that there is some military stuff. One person said to me that it was an intel base."
"Jenny" comment read aloud, stating "I was in the gates program. We spoke about that. They were big mad when we suggested that the military was working on kids in these programs."
"All biz" comment read aloud, expressing general support
"Michelle Miller" comment read aloud, asserting the investigation path was "meant to be" and converging themes
"KJO" comment read aloud, praising "Will the real Erica Kirk please stand up" segment
"Candy Catty" comment read aloud, requesting video clips be shown on screen

claims.label: TPUSA cease-and-desist letter states UVU prohibited TPUSA security drones but allowed a media production drone for B-roll
